g.text: One RTX 4090: PostgreSQL Map and a direct HTTP reference
Qwen2.5-7B, BF16, TP1; prefix cache reset before each cell. Warm-up excluded.
Repeat PG settings: L=64; input/result budgets 1/64 MiB; PG local window 64 MiB.
The first direct control is retained from an interrupted block. Rejected PG runs are excluded from rates.
Completed rows may contain wrong answers; quality and all failures are reported separately.
